rules: When the research package, style notes, outline, and visual plan (if any) are written and the writer's own gates passed, and the package is ready for the pre-draft review.
When the full draft package is written and ready for draft review, or after revisions that need a full-package re-review.

When the writer saves a research-request.md because the article needs online or paper research: several sources, current facts, or a check of claims the article will make. Include the request's absolute path and the work folder.
When review-report.md decides Pass: the writer delivers the final package to the user.
When review-report.md names a gap or revision (any decision other than Pass) and lists the required revisions.
When the research brief for the writer's research-request.md is saved. Include the brief's absolute path, the answer in a few sentences, and the open gaps.
